summary: refactor(settings): remove dead integration check in ConfirmSignupCode
description:
## Because

- `SignupConfirmCodeContainer` types its `integration` prop as non-optional.
- The `App` component already returns early when the integration is missing, before any page renders.
- The `if (!integration)` branch in the container was unreachable, and its TODO asked to move the check up the tree.

## This pull request

- Removes the unreachable `if (!integration)` early return, and the TODO comment above it, from `container.tsx`.
- Removes the two `expect(currentProps?.integration).toBeDefined()` assertions from `container.test.tsx`.

## Issue that this pull request solves

Closes: https://mozilla-hub.atlassian.net/browse/FXA-8853
